title: below 48 cells a child row's columns still shift by its indent
description:
The cg4 fix lets the WHAT column absorb a child row's 3-cell indent. When the pane is narrower than watchWhatFrom (48) the WHAT column drops, and the child's PIPELINE/TIME still sit 3 cells right of the parent rows — there is no WHAT cell to give the cells up, and the indent cannot come out of the identity column without cutting the id itself (lead 4 cells, id '+823' already 4 wide). Worth a deliberate decision: accept the shift at extreme narrowness, or shrink the child's lead to ' └ ' there. Not in cg4's scope: both goldens (120, 60) show WHAT, and the tick names the WHAT truncation as the fix.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_view.go dashCells.render: renderWatchFrame on a model with an indented child at width 40 gives ' t1    ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓  49m' beside '  └ +t1c  ✓ ✓ ✓ ✓  34m' — pipeline and time 3 cells right
